notes.title: RELEASE DATE SET!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello Players! 👋 [/h1]

[h2]We are excited to announce that the FULL version of Pet Shop Simulator will be released on June 21, 2024, at 3:00 PM CEST! 🔥[/h2]
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/6d0974b363035d1358f43e05ab5b6761568d2f29.png[/img]


Get ready for an even more immersive pet shop management experience, with new features, expanded gameplay and tons of new items to sell in your shop waiting for you! 🤩


📅Mark this date on your calendar and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of selling and running your own business! 🙂

[h3][b]Stay tuned for more updates and join us on launch day for an amazing adventure![/b][/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

[url=https://discord.gg/2q8Jtj2Gtt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Exciting news! 🐾 [/b]
The new Pet Shop Simulator Prologue update is now available![/h3]

We're happy to announce that the game is getting another batch of things you've been asking for and fixes for those bugs you've reported. 
The king of this update is definitely the new rabbit model 🐰 

Before update: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/11d415f401b9dbf76aaef56ee0196bd99d117a82.png[/img]

After update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/f18fa809042247558cd1d7ee06ea52e5dc9e0dcc.png[/img]


Here's a quick look at what's coming:

[b]Fixes and improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the saving of fish data.
[*] Resolved the problem of products locking up at checkout.
[*] Faster cleaning of cages and aquariums.
[*] People now leave less mess on the floor.
[*] Improved rabbit model
[/list]

Get ready to return to the world of pet shopping management with these improvements! Stay tuned for more details and unleash your inner pet store entrepreneur. 🐶🐱🐠 

See you soon,
Pet Shop Team

notes.title: Update | No Limits!
notes.content:
[h3]You’ve been consistently asking us to lift the three days limit for each individual playthrough for the Prologue version. This was the most frequently mentioned topic throughout the entire feedback. 📝

We are happy to see your thirst to develop your shops more and enjoy the gameplay.[/h3]


[h1]We do listen to your requests and as of today the limit has been lifted! 🤩[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/94bc99301f42483ceddff46ce0c50af43b08a615.png[/img]


[h3]You can enjoy the playthroughs to your heart's content! 👍 We’d like to thank everyone who already tried the Prologue and invite those of you who still haven’t to give it a try! 🐰

[b]We’re grateful for all your feedback so don’t forget to give us your opinions, ideas and suggestions in the discussion section or on our discord! 👇 If you enjoyed the Prologue, don’t forget to add the full version to your wishlists on Steam to not miss out on the Premiere. [/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/ 

[url=https://discord.gg/2q8Jtj2Gtt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png[/img][/url]
[b]
See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Open Your Pet Shop Now! 😻
notes.content:
[h2][b]We are happy to announce that the door to pet shop are open for everyone! 🥳[/b][/h2]

[h1][b]The free Prologue of Pet Shop Simulator is now available for play! 👇 [/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2778420/Pet_Shop_Simulator_Prologue/

Now each of you can open own pet shop in the free Prologue! 🐶 
This is just a some pices of what awaits you in the full version of the game. 😍

We are looking forward to your opinions, feedback, and ideas, which are crucial in the further development of the full version of the game. We really count on your feedback, you can do it on Community Hub or on our Discord, links are below 👇

📖 | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2778420/discussions/0/7252559508584452340/]PROLOGUE - SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]

🐛 | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2778420/discussions/0/7252559508584452398/]PROLOGUE - BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url]

💬 | [url=https://discord.gg/2q8Jtj2Gtt]Discord [/url]

📝 | Form - https://forms.gle/44WCGbCGy2FKPT7Z6


To open your own pet shop, all you need to do is go to the Prologue Steam page and download the game, it is completely free and available to everyone - open your et shop now! 🤩

[b]We can't wait to hear your opinions! 😊[/b]

[previewyoutube=FS_sc0tF9k0;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/2q8Jtj2Gtt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png[/img][/url]

Have fun! 😊
Pet Shop Simulator Team
